candidate.source: Steady-speed estimate, not a power-meter reading or training prescription. It assumes a straight road and constant conditions. Aero posture, tires, road surface, drafting, acceleration, elevation changes and weather can change real power. Negative downhill demand is shown as zero because this model does not estimate braking or regenerative power.
